name: MonarchAiDisclaimer
title: AiDisclaimer
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row with androidx.compose.material3.Text; MonarchInlineNotice for the high risk
summary: A short reminder that AI output can be wrong, worded and styled for a low, medium or high risk.
whenToUse: Under an AI composer or answer, with the risk set by how much harm a wrong answer could do where it appears: high for money, health, legal or deleting data.
whenNotToUse: To mark one piece of content as AI-generated use MonarchAiGeneratedBadge. For errors and other notices use MonarchInlineNotice or MonarchCalloutBanner.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiDisclaimer(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, risk: MonarchAiDisclaimerRisk = MonarchAiDisclaimerRisk.Low, text: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchAiDisclaimerRisk { Low, Medium, High }

options.name: risk
options.description: Low, Medium or High. Selects the wording and the look.

options.name: text
options.description: Replaces the built-in wording of the risk. Already localised. Null or blank text keeps the built-in wording.

options.name: icon
options.description: An icon before the text, tinted by the risk and hidden from TalkBack. Monarch bundles no icons.

states.name: low
states.description: A centered caption in the muted text color; the icon in the AI strong color.

states.name: medium
states.description: A caption at the start in the default text color; the icon in the info strong color.

states.name: high
states.description: A warning MonarchInlineNotice: the warning subtle fill with the text and icon in the warning strong color.

appearance: Low uses the muted text role and the AI strong role for the icon; medium the default text role and the info strong role for the icon; high the warning subtle fill and the warning strong role, as MonarchInlineNotice draws it. All roles come from the theme, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same three risks and wording as the web and iOS. The web draws a bot, information and warning glyph; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the icon is an optional slot and the text carries the meaning. The web marks the element with role note, which has no TalkBack equivalent; on Android it is one merged text element. Wording is replaced per call through text, or for every call through the string resources monarch_aidisclaimer_low, _medium and _high, rather than a messages object. Because every parameter is optional, modifier comes first, before risk and text, following the Compose API guidelines; iOS takes text first.
accessibility: The icon and the text are one TalkBack element, read as the text; the icon is hidden.
The high risk is read with the tone name "Warning" first, so the risk does not depend on color.
The text grows with the font size setting and wraps.
edgeCases: Long custom text wraps; the low risk stays centered.
Null or blank text falls back to the built-in wording of the risk.

examples.title: Low risk (default)
examples.code:
MonarchAiDisclaimer(
    risk = MonarchAiDisclaimerRisk.Low,
    text = "AI can make mistakes. Check important info.",
)

examples.title: High risk with an icon
Custom wording
examples.code:
MonarchAiDisclaimer(
    risk = MonarchAiDisclaimerRisk.Medium,
    text = "Summaries can leave out details. Open the thread for the full discussion.",
)
